biggest_catch: The study is a 1-year treatment period plus 6 months of observation with 9 clinic visits; half of participants receive placebo, and not everyone qualifies.
catches: Must be 12+ with asthma and already taking an asthma medication for symptom control; screening required.
Half of participants receive Dupixent, half receive placebo; home injections every 2 weeks.
Medical risks of dupilumab/placebo; blood draws and lung function testing at visits.

c1.evidence: Official page: 'Participants may receive up to $870, study medication, and asthma medication included in the study.'

c2.evidence: Official page: 'In this research study, we want to learn if the study drug Dupixent (dupilumab) helps to control your asthma.'

c3.evidence: Official page: 'Individuals 12 years of age and older with asthma and who already take an asthma medication for symptom control (daily inhaler or injections) may be eligible to enroll in the study.'

c4.evidence: Official page: 'The study consists of a one-year treatment period, followed by 6 months of observation. During the 1-year treatment period, we will ask you to come in for a study visit a total of 7 times... We will then follow up by phone and we will ask you to come in twice for a study visit during the observation phase.'

eligibility: Individuals 12 years of age and older with asthma who already take an asthma medication for symptom control (daily inhaler or injections). Blood draws at 5 time points; lung function testing at each visit.
notes: Listed on the official current-studies page; page presents the IDEA study as recruiting.
numeric_basis: 7 clinic visits (treatment year) + 2 clinic visits (observation) = 9 in-person visits per official page; per-visit duration (2-3h for exams, lung function, blood work) is estimated, not published: 9 x 2h = 1,080 min low, 9 x 3h = 1,620 min high; phone follow-ups not counted
payout_quote: Participants may receive up to $870, study medication, and asthma medication included in the study.
payout_value_note: Up to $870 plus study medication and asthma medication included in the study.

steps: Review the IDEA study details on the official Current Studies page.
Contact the Asthma and Allergy Clinical Research Center at Boston Children's Hospital to be screened.
If eligible, enroll and complete the 1-year treatment period (7 study visits) plus the 6-month observation phase (2 study visits), with at-home injections every 2 weeks.
Receive compensation of up to $870 plus study medication and asthma medication included in the study.
timing: One-year treatment period plus 6 months of observation: 7 study visits during treatment, 2 visits during observation, phone follow-ups, and at-home injections every 2 weeks.
